# Set Device Appearance

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Sets the devices appearance to the given style.

## Syntax

~~~~text
setAppearance(mode: <#String (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
setAppearance(mode: "Device Name")
~~~~
